### PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK KORBAN KEKERASAN I. UMUM

Tindak Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak merupakan pelanggaran hak asasi manusia sehingga perlu dilindungi harga diri dan martabatnya serta dijamun hak gidupnya sesuai dengan fitrah dan kodratnya tanpa diskriminasi. Dalam rangka mencegah dan menanggulangi Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak di Kabupaten Parigi Moutong agar terhindar dari Kekerasan, ancaman Kekerasan, penyiksaan atau perlakuan yang merendahkan derajat dan martabat kemanusiaan, perlu dilakukan perlindungan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan dalam bentuk peraturan di Daerah. Selama ini peraturan perundang-undangan yang mengatur mengenai perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan belum mengatur upaya perlindungan di Daerah sehingga diperlukan dukungan kelembagaan dan peraturan yang dapat menjamin pelaksanaannya. Peraturan Daerah ini mengatur upaya perlindungan bagi korban khususnya dalam hal pencegahan, pelayanan dan pemberdayaan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan di Kabupaten Parigi Moutong.

### PARTISIPASI MASYARAKAT DAN DUNIA USAHA

Pasa125 (1) Every person may participate in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

2. Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by:

a. preventing and stopping the occurrence of acts of violence;

b. providing protection to victims;

c. providing first aid to victims of acts of violence;

d. reporting acts of violence against women and/or children;

e. independently disseminating/raising awareness of the rights of women and children;

f. strengthening community social institutions in handling acts of violence against women and children; and/or

g. disseminating information about laws and regulations related to acts of violence against women and children.

Pasa126 (1) The Regional Government encourages the business sector to participate in the protection of women and children from acts of violence.

2. Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may take the form of:

a. socialization to employees within the company environment regarding the dangers of acts of violence against women and children; and

b. assistance as a form of corporate social responsibility.

### BABVID

SISTEM IIfFORMASI DAN PELAPORAN Pasa127 (1) The Regional Government prepares and compiles an information and reporting system for the protection of women and children from acts of violence. (2) The information and reporting system as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

### BABIX

### PEMBINAAN DAN PENGAWASAN

Pasa128 (1) The Regional Government conducts guidance and supervision of P2TP2A. (2) Guidance and supervision shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus tasked with and responsible for the field of women's empowerment and child protection. (3) The results of the implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2) must be reported to the Regent.

### BABX

### PEMBIAYAAN

Pasal29 Financing for the protection of women and children from acts of violence may be sourced from: ,a. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget; and/or

Pasal30 (1) The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations, or non-governmental organizations that carry out protection of women and children from acts of violence.

2. Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in accordance with the Regional financial capacity and implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

### BABXI

### KETENTUAN PERALIHAN

Pasal31 Activities for the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Acts of Violence organized by P2TP2A before this Regional Regulation is promulgated, are declared to remain valid until the establishment of the Technical Implementation Unit of the Women's and Children's Protection Service by the Regional Government.

### BABX

### KETENTUAN PENUTUP

Pasal32 This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

### TENTANG

### PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK KORBAN KEKERASAN I. UMUM

Acts of Violence against Women and Children constitute violations of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Parigi Moutong Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to provide protection to Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of regional regulations. Thus far, laws and regulations governing the protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, so institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Parigi Moutong Regency.

Sufficiently clear Article 8 Paragraph (1) Point a What is meant by "complaint services" is a series of actions carried out by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children submitted by victims, families or the community.

Point b What is meant by "health services" is efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects. Point c Sufficiently clear Point d Sufficiently clear Point e What is meant by "spiritual guidance" is a form of activity in which there is a process of spiritual guidance and coaching for humans so that it can provide peace, tranquility and coolness of heart to humans by always providing encouragement and motivation to remain patient, trust in God and continue to carry out their obligations.

Point f What is meant by "social rehabilitation services" is services aimed at restoring and developing the abilities of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

Point g . What is meant by "legal aid and legal assistance services" is legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to carry out the process of assisting witnesses and/ or victims of violence against women and children that are gender sensitive.

Point h Sufficiently clear Point i What is meant by "repatriation and reintegration" is an effort to return women and children victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation point/ entry point, or from the receiving region Paragraph (2) to the region of origin.
